"""Week 3 config (day 21). Cash $888.8k. 156 S1 subs, 0 churn yet. S2 ~at quality floor.
Theme: relieve #1 complaint (S1 quota walls) before retention cliff (d31-51); trim low-value
global dev for runway; keep targeted S2 dev to OPEN S2 next week. Hold R&D/research."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1) Daily spend: cut global dev $1500->$1000 (log-saturating, low marginal value; does NOT delay
#    S2 since targeted dev dominates). Bump ops $250->$350 (cheap retention insurance before cliff;
#    issues resolve same-day at $250 but subs scaling to ~250 next wk + reduces outage prob).
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=350.0, development=1000.0)

# 2) Targeted dev: KEEP S2 $2000/day. Plan C delivered 0.3529 -> clears 0.37 floor ~d23, ~0.40 by d28.
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 2000.0})

# 3) QUOTA FIX: raise Plan A 200->350 (+75%). Dominant social complaint = power users locked out
#    mid-batch (eyeing Jasper). Most S1 use ~91/day (unaffected); only power users gain. Small compute
#    cost at T2, big retention/reputation value before cliff. (Defer T1-tier compute optimization to wk5.)
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=350, B=450, C=900)

# 4) Ads: KEEP content_marketing S1 $600 (145 leads/$1k, NOT saturating) + social S1 $100.
#    (set_targeted_ad_spend REPLACES full budget -> must respecify all.) Hold S1 acq ~flat pending cliff.
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 600.0},
    "social_media":      {"S1": 100.0},
})

# 5) Lead promo: KEEP S1 $8 (eff $6 -> 13.7% conv). No S2 promo yet (quality still ~at floor; promo
#    cannot open S2 until delivered Q > floor 0.37 — next week).
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 8.0})

# 6) ads_strength 0 (quality is the moat, esp. for S2's high floor). Prices/tiers UNCHANGED.
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0)

print("Week 3 config applied.")
